description: BC Airports is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of British Columbia | Gouvernment de la Colombie-Britannique. BC Airports identifies locations where aircraft may take-off and land. No guarantee is given that an identified point will be maintained to sufficient standards for landing and take-off of any/all aircraft. It includes airports, aerodromes, water aerodromes, heliports, and airstrips. Coverage: Government of British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Government of British Columbia | Gouvernment de la Colombie-Britannique. Its tags are airport, airports and heliports, sites registry, transportation, Government information. It offers 6 resource(s) in HTML, KML, WMS, XLS. The portal shows 2026-01-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
